summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HVDC/reactive-power/grid-stability equipment node with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: Hubbell as a large-cap utility T&D component anchor with bushings/connectors/substation exposure. Underfollowed lane: Preformed Line Products as a transmission-line hardware pure-play adjacent to grid buildout; American Superconductor as a small-cap grid-stability/reactive-compensation supplier; Vishay as a mid-cap passive-components supplier with documented HVDC/STATCOM capacitor applications. Key caveat: several names are adjacent rather than pure HVDC reactor suppliers, so later layers must verify revenue mix, customer approvals, backlog, and whether HVDC/grid-stability exposure is material rather than catalog-level.
